newsitem.title: CHINA: Indonesia's Jasindo unit completes US$50 mln FRN.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia's Jasindo unit completes US$50 mln FRN.

text.p: Rekasaran BI Ltd, a unit of PT Asuransi Jasa Indonesia (Jasindo), has completed a US$50 million floating rate notes issue due July 16, 1999, lead manager Credit Agricole Indosuez Hong Kong said on Friday.
The deal is guaranteed by Jasindo, which is wholly-owned by the Indonesian government.
The two-year notes has a put option on the first anniversary. They were issued at par to float at 75 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
The guarantor has received BBB claims-paying ability rating from Standard & Poor's.
